WEB-POKE-E1.description_markdown:
## Context

Implements [RFC 0001 — Pokémon infinite list with a caching proxy](https://github.com/rarescrisan/day54/blob/develop/docs/rfcs/0001-pokemon-infinite-list.md): a `/pokemon` page in `apps/web` that renders an infinite-scrolling list, fed by a same-app route handler (`GET /api/pokemon`) that proxies PokeAPI behind an in-memory cache.

This is the repo's first route handler, first external service call, and first client-side data fetch — a deliberately small end-to-end exercise of the conventions.

## Scope

- WEB-POKE-1 — the proxy route handler with Zod validation and the module-level cache
- WEB-POKE-2 — the `/pokemon` page and the `PokemonList` client component
- WEB-POKE-3 — Playwright e2e plus the three `docs/architecture/` spec updates

## Out of scope

Search, detail pages, persistence, shared caching, auth (local-only app), rate-limit handling beyond surfacing an error.

WEB-POKE-1.summary: [API] Pokémon proxy route handler with in-memory cache
WEB-POKE-1.description_markdown:
## Context

RFC 0001 (`docs/rfcs/0001-pokemon-infinite-list.md`). First route handler in `apps/web` — `API_SPEC.md` currently states the app has none. The proxy lives in `apps/web`, **not** `apps/api`: the architecture spec forbids web → api calls.

## Requirements

- `apps/web/src/app/api/pokemon/route.ts`: `GET /api/pokemon?offset&limit`, proxying `https://pokeapi.co/api/v2/pokemon`. The base URL is a module constant, not an env var (no `turbo.json` `globalEnv` change).
- Query params validated with a Zod schema (`pokemonQuerySchema`): `offset` integer ≥ 0, default 0; `limit` integer 1–50, default 20. Invalid input → `400` with `{ error }`, upstream never called.
- Response shape `{ items: [{ id, name, spriteUrl }], nextOffset }` — `id` parsed from the trailing segment of PokeAPI's item URL, `spriteUrl` built from the official sprites CDN pattern, `nextOffset` is `null` on the last page.
- Module-level `Map` cache keyed by `offset:limit`. Only `200` upstream responses are cached. No TTL, no eviction (roster is ~65 pages — naturally bounded).
- Upstream non-2xx / network error → `502` with `{ error }`, never cached.
- New dev/runtime deps (`zod`, `msw` for tests) pinned exactly; `pnpm-workspace.yaml` `minimumReleaseAge` blocks versions younger than 7 days, so pin accordingly.
- Tests in `route.test.ts` with an MSW node server — mock at the network boundary only, never our own modules.

## Acceptance

- `pnpm turbo run test --filter web` passes.
- A test proves the second identical request is served from cache: MSW upstream request count stays at 1.
- A test proves invalid `offset`/`limit` returns `400` and the upstream is never called.
- A test proves upstream `500` → `502`, and a subsequent retry succeeds (failures are not cached).
- `pnpm turbo run lint typecheck --filter web` passes.

WEB-POKE-2.description_markdown: ## Context RFC 0001. Consumes `GET /api/pokemon` from WEB-POKE-1. Mirrors the repo's server/client reference pair: the page stays a Server Component, the interactive leaf is the client component (`page.tsx` / `counter.tsx` pattern). ## Requirements - `apps/web/src/app/pokemon/page.tsx` — Server Component shell with the page heading. - `apps/web/src/components/pokemon-list.tsx` — `"use client"` leaf. Named export, explicit return type, exported props interface, kebab-case file name (see `.claude/WRITING_GUIDELINES.md`; copy the shape of `packages/ui/src/button.tsx`). - Fetches offset 0 on mount and renders rows (name + sprite), each row a list item with an accessible name. Sprites as plain `` with explicit width/height — no `next/image` config wiring. - An `IntersectionObserver` sentinel after the last row fetches the next page when visible, `nextOffset` is non-null, and no request is in flight. - Loading status rendered with `aria-live="polite"` (same announcement pattern as the counter). - On fetch failure: stop auto-loading, show the error and a **Retry** button that re-requests the failed offset. - When `nextOffset` is `null`: unobserve the sentinel, render an end-of-list message. - Plain `useState`/`useRef` — no data-fetching library (RFC rejects TanStack Query/SWR for one list). - Tests in `pokemon-list.test.tsx` (Vitest + Testing Library + MSW, `IntersectionObserver` stubbed — jsdom has none), querying by role and accessible name. ## Acceptance - `pnpm turbo run test --filter web` passes. - Tests cover: first page renders by accessible name; an intersection triggers exactly one append; failure shows **Retry** and retrying recovers; no further fetches after the last page. - `pnpm turbo run lint typecheck --filter web` passes.

WEB-POKE-3.summary: [QA] Pokémon e2e flow and architecture spec updates
WEB-POKE-3.description_markdown:
## Context

RFC 0001, final wave: prove the flow end to end in a real browser and keep `docs/architecture/` truthful (per the maintain-architecture-docs convention — this change touches the HTTP surface, external dependencies, and user-facing behavior, so all three specs move in the same change).

## Requirements

- `apps/web/e2e/pokemon.spec.ts` — Playwright, with `page.route` intercepting `/api/pokemon`; the test must not depend on pokeapi.co being reachable.
- Assert: the `/pokemon` heading and first-page rows are reachable by accessible name; scrolling the sentinel into view loads and appends a second page.
- `docs/architecture/API_SPEC.md` — replace the "no route handlers" paragraph with a `GET /api/pokemon` entry in the documented template (handler, auth, request, response, side effects).
- `docs/architecture/FEATURE_SPEC.md` — add a "Pokémon list" entry (route, behavior, tests).
- `docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE_SPEC.md` — amend "Data and persistence": name PokeAPI as an outbound dependency of `apps/web` and describe the per-process in-memory cache and its limits.

## Acceptance

- `pnpm turbo run e2e --filter web` passes.
- `API_SPEC.md` no longer claims `apps/web` has no route handlers; all three specs mention the new route/feature/dependency.

WEB-POKE-1.1.summary: Add zod and msw, pinned exactly
WEB-POKE-1.1.description_markdown: `apps/web/package.json`: `zod` as a dependency, `msw` as a devDependency, both exact versions older than 7 days (`minimumReleaseAge`). `.npmrc` already sets `save-exact=true`.

WEB-POKE-1.2.description_markdown: In the route module: Zod schema for `offset` (int ≥ 0, default 0) and `limit` (int 1–50, default 20), plus the exported `PokemonPage` response types (`items`, `nextOffset`).

WEB-POKE-1.3.description_markdown: `apps/web/src/app/api/pokemon/route.ts`: validate query → fetch PokeAPI (base URL a module constant) → reshape to `{ items: [{ id, name, spriteUrl }], nextOffset }`. Invalid input → 400; upstream failure → 502.

WEB-POKE-1.4.description_markdown: Module-level `Map<string, PokemonPage>` keyed `offset:limit`; consult before fetching, populate only on upstream 200. No TTL, no eviction.

WEB-POKE-1.5.description_markdown: `route.test.ts` (Vitest + MSW): happy path reshape; cache hit (upstream request count stays 1); invalid params → 400 with no upstream call; upstream 500 → 502 and not cached (retry succeeds).

WEB-POKE-2.1.description_markdown: `apps/web/src/app/pokemon/page.tsx`: Server Component with the page heading, rendering `<PokemonList />`. No `"use client"` here.

WEB-POKE-2.2.description_markdown: `apps/web/src/components/pokemon-list.tsx` (`"use client"`): fetch offset 0 on mount, render list items with accessible names, sprite as plain `` with width/height. Shape per `packages/ui/src/button.tsx` conventions.

WEB-POKE-2.3.description_markdown: Sentinel element after the last row; on intersect, fetch `nextOffset` iff non-null and nothing in flight, append items. Unobserve + end-of-list message when `nextOffset` is null.

WEB-POKE-2.4.description_markdown: `aria-live="polite"` loading status; on fetch failure stop auto-loading and render the error with a **Retry** button that re-requests the failed offset.

WEB-POKE-2.5.description_markdown: Component tests with `IntersectionObserver` stubbed (jsdom has none), MSW at the network boundary, queries by role/accessible name: first render, one append per intersection, Retry recovery, stop at last page.

WEB-POKE-3.1.description_markdown: `apps/web/e2e/pokemon.spec.ts` with `page.route` intercepting `/api/pokemon` (no dependency on pokeapi.co): heading and rows by accessible name; scrolling loads a second page.

WEB-POKE-3.2.description_markdown: Replace the "no route handlers" paragraph in `docs/architecture/API_SPEC.md` with a `GET /api/pokemon` entry in the documented template (handler, auth, request, response, side effects).

WEB-POKE-3.3.description_markdown: `FEATURE_SPEC.md`: add the "Pokémon list" entry (route, behavior, tests). `ARCHITECTURE_SPEC.md`: amend "Data and persistence" with PokeAPI as an outbound dependency of `apps/web` and the per-process cache.
